text:
Introduction
Welcome to our Feats System channel, the purpose of these challenges is to give you fun objectives to aim for at various encounters, aiming to provide a challenge disregarding any meta whatsoever of farming kills. Happy hunting!
​
All submissions require supporting evidence to be reviewed by staff.
​
Submitting for a Role
A submission should be provided as follows, with your in-game name visible:
⬥ Feat name
⬥ Supporting video evidence
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Only videos are accepted unless otherwise stated



















Feats System Rules
⬥ All rules used by the PvM Records community apply
    • Full list is available here.
    • Any new bugs/exploits added to the list that are used prior to being disallowed may result in submission denial.
⬥ Power creep may place submissions on hold.
⬥ Deathtouched darts are not allowed for any feat..








Seasonal Feats
These temporary feats will regularly rotate with new choices and are for the real feat lovers.
Current season: September 2nd - December 31st
​



















@Rooted in Fear
⬥ Defeat Beastmaster Durzag solo without kiting him
    • Does not need to include the horde

@A Catastrophe
⬥ Defeat Amascut at 4,000% enrage while entering phase 7 with 9m+ hp

@Coven's Curse
⬥ Defeat Zamorak at 4,000% enrage without using an ultimate ability








PvME Special Roles


















⬥ "Roles" = Feats only
⬥ Seasonal feats are not required for these roles

Available Roles
@Party Queue
    • Obtain all feats up to and including Adept tier

@Feat Enjoyer
    • Obtain all feats up to and including Master tier

@Featured
    • Obtain all feats up to and including Grandmaster tier

@deFeated
    • Obtain all feat roles








Please post your submissions in #role-submissions so that they can be reviewed by staff and/or role reviewers. Submissions will be evaluated according to our rules, as follows:
Initiate Feats
These feats are for those who mastered the basics of a boss and want to start pushing themselves further.
​



















@Killer Tick
⬥ **Kill 1 boss in the least ticks possible as recognised by PvM Records

@nopenope
⬥ Complete a solo Araxxor kill while executing a top path heal skip

@Solo BM
⬥ Solo Beastmaster Durzag**
    • Must include the hoard

@Nature's Wrath
⬥ Defeat Solak with the Wrath curse dealing the final blow
    • For this you must die to the instakill attack caused by Solak's mind dying
@Duo Mirage
⬥ Duo Yakamaru (Mirage phase)

@Fight Club
⬥ Complete a hardmode Tzkal-Zuk run after clearing the triple jad wave with only your fists

@Skippy McSkipface
⬥ Kill Seiryu in a single cycle, skip the BSD flight phase, and skip the Ambassador spinner phase in solo instances.
    • In a row not required








​
Adept Feats
A stuntman rises from the ashes. The encounters in this bracket will test your game knowledge and combat improvisation.
​



















@Gold Daredevil
Achieve Golden Daredevil
    • A list of the daredevil feats can be found here
    • A screenshot of the achievement in the CA interface can be used in place of
 a video

@True Warden
⬥ Kill Telos at 4000% enrage

@Frostbite
⬥ 200ks at Arch-Glacor
    • Screenshot is acceptable
@nopenopenope
⬥ Complete the Lumbridge strikes back achievement at 300% enrage on the top path of Araxxor
    • Must use a Spirit Spider familiar

@Solo Vorago NM 6/6
⬥ Solo Vorago NM on all 6 weeks

@Silver Defeater
⬥ Duo Vorago HM on all 6 weeks

@Lord of Chaos
⬥ Kill Zamorak at 4000% in a group








​
Master Feats
The Daredevil rises. Your consistency is unparalleled and your guts immeasurable.
​



















@Last Man Standing
⬥ Defeat 4000% enrage Telos after killing all minions that spawn on phases 4 and 5

@Ice Cold
⬥ Kill Arch-Glacor at 4000% enrage

@Wrath of Chaos
⬥ Kill Zamorak at 4000% enrage in solo
@Animaster
⬥ 200ks at Telos
    • Screenshot is acceptable

@Zarosian Prodigy
⬥ Solo AoD

@Solo Mirage
⬥ Solo Yakamaru (Mirage phase)

@Master of Omens
⬥ Solo Hard Mode Vorago

@God of Destruction
⬥ Kill Amascut at 4000% enrage








​
Grandmaster Feats
Some would call you crazy, others a madman. We prefer to call you a Feats Fiend.
​



















@Golden Defeater
⬥ Solo Hard Mode Vorago on all 6 weeks

@True Animaster
⬥ 200ks at Telos with 4000% enrage start
    • No darts allowed
    • Must provide VODs + chests + quick chat KC
        ⬩ Provide this for any kill between 2nd-10th AND final kill

@Emberstruck
⬥ Defeat Zamorak at 4000% enrage without overhead prayers or food demo
    • No infernus teleporting during green/red hp allowed

@Anima-bound
⬥ Defeat Telos at 4000% enrage without overhead prayers or food demo

@Twisted Tails
⬥ Kill Amascut at 2000% enrage as a Duo
    • Must intercept every blinking strike on phase 5 after reforming Tumeken








Insane Feats
Only the most reckless fighters would attempt such encounters, consistency and extreme skill are in display for the most gruelling challenges in this bracket.
​



















@Eternal Frostbite
⬥ 200ks at Arch-glacor with 4000% enrage start
    • No darts allowed
    • Must provide VODs + chests + quick chat KC
        ⬩ Provide this for any kill between 2nd-10th AND final kill

@Messiah of Mazcab
⬥ Achieve Golden Daredevil in duo
    • A list of the daredevil feats can be found here
    • This includes puzzle completion

@Hypothermic
⬥ Defeat Arch-Glacor at 4000% enrage without overhead prayers or food demo

@A Tail of Two Cats
⬥ Kill Amascut at 4000% enrage as a Duo
    • Must intercept every blinking strike on phase 5 after reforming Tumeken
